messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty PDR-84591 fired for service=usage-aggregator, symptom=checksum_drift_detected, severity=high
ryan_oncall: Acked PDR-84591. I'm jumping on it. any immediate customer-facing impact tagged? :eyes:
maya_sre: seeing token_count deltas on the EMEA ingest shard, counts are ~2-5% lower vs expected across a 12h window. likely aggregation stage corruption or duplicate dedupe regression.
alex_eng: copying logs now. suspected commit that rolled through yesterday to consumers: 2026-03-12 21:03 - kafka-consumer: bump-buffer-optim. I'm running a quick compare between raw events and aggregated counts.
samops: FYI billing-queue shows invoices in draft with missing token totals for ~1200 accounts (recent 24h). marking invoice risk. tagging @amy_billing for customer impact triage.
amy_billing: looking. high priority customers flagged: AcmeCorp, LumenAI, and two others on monthly billing. Potential invoice undercount for usage in the 3/11-3/13 window. Please confirm scope before we pause billing.
ryan_oncall: immediate mitigation options? can we re-run aggregation for the affected time ranges or fallback to previous aggregator replica?
maya_sre: short-term: we can switch traffic to aggregator v2 (read-only replica) which has last good checkpoint at 2026-03-12T20:30Z. That will stop further drift. Rerun re-aggregation for the window 2026-03-11T00:00Z -> 2026-03-13T00:00Z afterwards.
alex_eng: repro steps showed this diff in reducer logic: ```diff
- if (seenIdSet.has(id)) continue;
+ if (!seenIdSet.has(id)) continue; // oops reversed condition
```
That explains lost tokens on duplicates. rolling a patch now.
samops: can we do a hotfix rollback instead? quicker to restore correct counts.
ryan_oncall: preference to rollback to v1 for immediate customer safety. patch in prod carries risk. we need to avoid double-counting too.
amy_billing: if we rollback, what's the ETA to reprocess invoices? we need estimate for outreach.
maya_sre: rollback -> 10m to flip traffic and validate. reprocess run: ~45m per 24h window, so for the 48h window estimate 1.5h total on the re-aggregation cluster if we parallelize. Validation an extra 20m.
alex_eng: rollback initiated: `deploy rollback usage-aggregator v1.42.8 --namespace=prod`
ops-bot: deploy started by alex_eng at 2026-03-15T18:12:04Z — build b590f3 -> rolling to 3 replicas
ryan_oncall: monitoring checks: token-count-monitoring dashboards refreshing. watching for divergence to converge to expected.
maya_sre: after rollback we saw counts reconcile in the staging delta job. Kicking off re-aggregation for 2026-03-11..2026-03-13 now: `./jobs/reagg --from 2026-03-11T00:00Z --to 2026-03-13T00:00Z --parallel=4`
samops: running smoke check against AcmeCorp sample: previous counts 1,240, expected 1,305, post-reagg sample 1,304. good.
amy_billing: starting targeted outreach to the 4 customers. drafting email: "We detected an undercount in recent usage; we will reprocess and update invoices. No action required on your side." I'll post the copy here for review.
ryan_oncall: escalation note: PagerDuty acknowledged and resolved once rollback validated? please update PDR ticket with timeline and postmortem assignee.
incident-bot: PDR-84591 status changed to acknowledged -> resolved at 2026-03-15T18:32:13Z by ryan_oncall (reason: rollback + reaggregation successful).
alex_eng: root cause: inverted dedupe condition introduced in consumer PR #8812 (code review slipped), deployed 2026-03-12 21:03Z. Remedial: add CI fuzz tests for duplicate ordering, add a canary gate for aggregator reducers, and require a token-count regression check in release playbook.
maya_sre: postmortem owner: maya_sre. ETA for draft: 2026-03-18. I'll include impact table (customers, tokens delta, invoices affected) and remediation steps.
amy_billing: will hold invoice finalization for affected accounts until reprocessed invoices confirmed. I'll update finance ops channel once final numbers are in.
ryan_oncall: thanks all. closing thread but keeping the follow-up tasks visible. :heart:
